title: Experiencing a Syntax Error with Latest InstantSearch 4.33.0 version with NextJS / Javascript
body: Hi there, I'm new to Algolia Search and was trying to install and run Instantsearch.js on my NextJS installation. However, after installing v4.33.0, or even trying to backtrack to v4.32.0, but both versions seemed to be throwing this `SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'export'` every time I attempted to run my setup. Attaching the screenshots on what I'm seeing: --- Hope someone can help assist or redirect me at potentially what I might be doing wrong? Thank you. --- "algoliasearch": "^4.11.0", "instantsearch.js": "^4.33.0", "next": "latest",
